notes.title: DEMO v2.0 is Available.
notes.content:
🎮 Hello Everyone!
Demo v2.0 is now live! In this new version, the content from the previous demo has been expanded, and a few new features have been added. However, this demo still offers a prologue experience that lasts around 10-20 minutes.
All features will be available in the full version of the game. Development is still ongoing, and we are getting closer to completion.

The purpose of the demo is to learn the core mechanics and gather clues about the origin of the virus. This version represents only a small part of the game and offers a limited-time experience.

🚀 What's New in Demo v2.0?
• New missions:
o Single-player mode
o Story Transition Level (2 Levels)
o Weapon and behavior mechanics
o Facing zombie attacks
o 5 scenario missions

• Isometric city map
• Improved graphics and sound effects
• A smoother and more enjoyable gameplay experience

The demo covers only 1% of the full game. Maps are limited, and all functions are locked. Simulation features are not included in v2.0.

Optimization efforts are ongoing to ensure a good experience even on low-end systems. However, this version is still in the testing phase, so you may encounter bugs and crashes. Please report any issues on our Discord channel or forums.

✅ Enjoy the game! Don’t forget to add the full game to your wishlist!
